title: Choose u and dv
text: Let $$u=x$$ and $$dv=sin\left(2x\right) dx$$, so $$du=dx$$ and $$v=-\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) cos\left(2x\right)$$.

title: Apply integration by parts
text: The integral equals $$-\left(\frac{1}{2}\right) x cos\left(2x\right)$$ plus the integral of $$\frac{1}{2} cos\left(2x\right)$$, which is $$\frac{1}{4} sin\left(2x\right)$$.
